'''Pearpair''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Solpear]] at 6 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Two of em' huddling together did not make things any better. Two heads, double the worries."

Pearpair is an early game, purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Pearpair is a duo of [[Solpear]]s hugging. They both retain the exact appearance of its pre-evo, just the right Solpear is mirrored. 

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "There seem to be two pears in your [[camp]]. One's a Solpear, and the other is its twin."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Once Pearpair finds their other half, the two will stay inseparable and help each other shoulder the emotional burden of existence."

==Strategy==
[[File:Pearpair Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Pearpair's attack range]]
Good mid game tank. Use until better Grass tank is acquired, or in case of heavy Rock [[Zobos|Zobo]] assault.
